v2026_11_pilot_draft_1.title: Legal review pending — Terms of Service
v2026_11_pilot_draft_1.intro: Legal review pending — Welcome to Interdomestik Asistenca. These terms govern your membership.

sections.membership: Legal review pending — Membership is valid for 1 year from the date of purchase. It includes access to our protection network and discount mediation.
sections.services: Legal review pending — We provide claim handling assistance, legal consultation, and damage assessment.
sections.fees: Legal review pending — Membership fees are non-refundable after the 30-day launch refund window closes. Success fees apply only upon successful claim recovery.

billing.eyebrow: Legal review pending — Annual membership terms
billing.title: Legal review pending — Annual billing, cancellation, and refund rules
billing.subtitle: Legal review pending — The same contract applies on pricing, at checkout, and in member settings.

annualBilling.title: Legal review pending — Annual billing in v1
annualBilling.body: Legal review pending — Memberships are billed annually at launch. Public pricing shows the yearly fee and paid term before checkout starts.

cancellation.title: Legal review pending — Cancellation stops the next renewal
cancellation.body: Legal review pending — You can cancel renewal at any time. Access stays active until the current paid term ends, and cancellation does not reopen expired benefits.

refundWindow.title: Legal review pending — 30-day launch refund window
refundWindow.body: Legal review pending — We refund the membership fee if you ask within 30 days of purchase and no staff-led recovery matter has been accepted for that membership yet.

coolingOff.title: Legal review pending — Cooling-off rights stay separate
coolingOff.body: Legal review pending — Any statutory cooling-off or withdrawal right applies separately from the launch refund promise. Where local law gives a different withdrawal window, that statutory rule controls.

acceptedMatters.title: Legal review pending — Accepted escalations survive cancellation
acceptedMatters.body: Legal review pending — If Interdomestik has already accepted a recovery matter, the agreed success-fee and escalation terms stay in force for that accepted matter even if the membership later cancels.

footer.title: Legal review pending — What the refund covers
footer.body: Legal review pending — The launch refund covers the membership fee only. It does not erase fees or partner costs already agreed for an accepted escalation.

v2026_11_pilot_draft_1.title: Legal review pending — Privacy Policy
v2026_11_pilot_draft_1.intro: Legal review pending — Your privacy is important to us. Included in your membership is strict data protection.

handling.title: Legal review pending — How we handle your data
handling.body: Legal review pending — We collect only the information required to provide membership services, process claims, and comply with legal obligations. Access is restricted by role and tenant scope.

rights.title: Legal review pending — Your rights
rights.body: Legal review pending — You can request access to your stored data, request correction, and request deletion where legally permitted.

deletion.title: Legal review pending — Deletion requests
deletion.body: Legal review pending — Authenticated users can submit a deletion request using the endpoint below with an optional JSON body.
deletion.followup: Legal review pending — Requests are logged as compliance events and reviewed by operations before irreversible deletion actions are performed.
